method: Read-only source audit and closed-bag correlation

facts.fact: Successful existing-trajectory planning sleeps until the requested trajectory_start_time before constructing and returning the candidate.
Moving dynamic repair rejects candidates whose activation lead after return is below20ms. The guarded stopped-repair rebase branch is separate.
Missing/mismatched/stale controller progress falls back to unscaled wall elapsed time; freshness limit is500ms in captured parameters.
Nominal valid rollout with external_gap>=.12 returns without broader base maneuvers. All27 deliveries in the measured approach window were nominal.

deployment_boundary: Captured main executable/source hashes and runtime logs retained. This file does not claim full binary-to-source provenance for all linked libraries. Detailed agent audit may provide additional matching evidence.
